description: This file implements a plugin module 'mod_ajp13' for the lighttpd web server, providing support for the Apache JServ Protocol version 1.3 (AJP13). It handles AJP13 request creation, header encoding/decoding, and response processing, integrating with the server's plugin architecture to act as an AJP13 gateway.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges configuration values related to AJP13 server, balance, debug level, and extension mapping into the plugin configuration.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges a single plugin configuration value into the existing plugin configuration.

methods.name: void mod_ajp13_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Creates a working configuration for a request by copying defaults and overriding with per-request specific configurations.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_set_defaults
methods.description: Initializes plugin configuration with default values and processes configuration directives.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint32_t ajp13_dec_uint16(const uint8_t * const x)
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from network byte order.

methods.name: void ajp13_enc_uint16_nc(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into buffer in network byte order without bounds checking.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_uint16(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into buffer with size check.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_byte(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const uint32_t v)
methods.description: Encodes a single byte into buffer with size check.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_string(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const char * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Encodes a string with length prefix and null terminator into buffer, handling special cases for empty and maximum length strings.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_stdin_append(handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Appends data chunks to the request body for the AJP13 protocol, respecting maximum packet size and request ID tracking.

methods.name: void ajp13_stdin_append_n(handler_ctx * const hctx,const uint32_t n)
methods.description: Appends a specific amount of data to the request body, handling special packet for zero-length body.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint8_t ajp13_method_byte(const http_method_t m)
methods.description: Maps HTTP method enumeration to corresponding AJP13 method byte.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_request_headers(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes the HTTP request headers into the AJP13 format, including special handling for known headers.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_attribute(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,const buffer * const b,uint8_t code)
methods.description: Encodes a request attribute into the AJP13 attribute format.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_attributes(uint8_t * const x,uint32_t n,request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes various request environment variables and headers as AJP13 attributes.

methods.name: uint32_t ajp13_enc_server_name(uint8_t * const x,const uint32_t n,const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Encodes the server name as a string in AJP13 format, handling IPv6 and port parsing.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_create_env(handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Creates the environment data and constructs the AJP13 request packet to be sent to the backend.

methods.name: int ajp13_expand_headers(buffer * const b,handler_ctx * const hctx,uint32_t plen)
methods.description: Decodes AJP13 headers packet from the backend into HTTP response headers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t ajp13_recv_0(const request_st * const r,const handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Handles end-of-request scenario when connection is closed unexpectedly.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_recv_parse_loop(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Main parse loop handling AJP13 response packets from the backend, updating response headers and body accordingly.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_recv_parse(request_st * const r,struct http_response_opts_t * const opts,buffer * const b,size_t n)
methods.description: Receives data from the network, appends to buffer, and invokes parse loop.

methods.name: handler_t ajp13_check_extension(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Checks if the requested URI matches the extension mapping and initializes the handler context for AJP13 processing.

methods.name: int mod_ajp13_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering callbacks and configurations with the lighttpd server.

methods.name: SETDEFAULTS_FUNC(mod_ajp13_set_defaults)
methods.description: unavailable
